headline: fshindo falls out of the ARC-3 gold places

sections.text: fshindo dropped from 19th to 20th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board, with the score unchanged at 38.20, and is now the first team outside the gold places.
The gold line, the score of the last gold place, rose 0.02 in the past day to 38.22, so fshindo is 0.02 short of it. Public standings remain provisional.
